description: This file defines the DLMClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager service. It includes method annotations for operations related to lifecycle policies such as creating, deleting, retrieving, tagging, and updating policies.

classes.name: DLMClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) service via AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: createLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Creates a new lifecycle policy in AWS DLM.

methods.name: deleteLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Deletes an existing lifecycle policy in AWS DLM.

methods.name: getLifecyclePolicies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of lifecycle policies.

methods.name: getLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific lifecycle policy.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags attached to a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds or overwrites tags for a resource.
